lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a staggered grid posterior to the branchial region, with the highest concentration of distinct local maxima situated in the mid-flank area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a visible rectilinear lattice across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges running longitudinally along the upper flank, each defined by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-luminance top edges to lower-intensity shadows below.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an associated remora (Echeneidae) visible in the water column immediately ventral to the mid-posterior flank.
